decisions.decision: Existing prior art, primary intervention failed success criterion.
ACon2 2023 and TOAD-ML 2026 overlap; RED v1.1 corrections supersede original descriptive findings. Not pursued as a novel method.

decisions.candidate: Transaction account-role history for cold signers
decisions.decision: Empirical novelty candidate supported: cold-signer declared-account execution-risk benchmark. Two original time windows pass; a third original cold-history gain is uncertain; identity control is mixed. A refined first-appearance endpoint was fixed before untouched November29–December1 records: identity-controlled AP gain +0.031613, CI95 +0.016816 to +0.050119, 17904 first appearances. Reserved refined gate passes. No new-algorithm, globally-first or publication-ready claim.

research_claim: Delayed-feedback execution-risk ranking for sampled first-appearance Solana signers using non-signer writable participation, after structure, signer, readonly/template history and learned identity control.
literature_limit: Exact benchmark not located among reviewed primary sources; this does not establish absence from all prior literature.
